metadata.title: Rogue Echo Bike V3.0 connectivity source registry
metadata.target: Rogue Echo Bike V3.0 standard connected console
metadata.method: web research, official documentation review, public repository retrieval, local static inspection
metadata.source_policy: Official manufacturer and standards sources first; working implementations second; community sources only for operational corroboration.
metadata.copyright_policy: Links and short factual notes are preserved for source auditing. Full Bluetooth SIG specification text is not redistributed. Public code snapshots retain attribution and licence notes.

sources.title: Rogue Echo Bike V3.0 product page
supports: V3.0 console has Bluetooth and ANT+ compatibility
standard V3 versus optional M2 distinction
limitations: Product copy does not enumerate every FTMS field or prove ANT+ bike-metric broadcast.

sources.title: Rogue Echo Bike V3.0 console product page
supports: V3 console can receive HR via ANT+ or BLE
console uses FTMS for two-way app/console-bike communication
limitations: The localized page is product documentation rather than a packet-level conformance report.

sources.title: Firmware update for V3 Console (Android)
supports: connect to the console inside the app rather than normal Bluetooth settings
limitations: The guide is about firmware/update workflow and does not provide a full GATT field map.

sources.title: Firmware update for V3 Console (iOS)
supports: FTMS statement and in-app connection workflow
limitations: No full packet capture or ANT+ metric map.

sources.title: Connect external devices to the console (iOS)
supports: Echo does not appear as an ordinary phone Bluetooth device
limitations: The guide focuses on external sensors and does not state which bike metrics ANT+ broadcasts.

sources.title: Echo Bike V3.0 Customer Instructions
supports: V3.0 physical assembly and sensor/cable context
limitations: Assembly instructions are not a BLE protocol manual.
